title: Squid Game Doll
blurb: The Squid Game doll's song — 'mugunghwa kkoci pieotseumnida' — sung sweetly before the shooting starts. It's the most unsettling nursery rhyme on television, and it triggered a global wave of playground Red Light Green Light. Play it and watch everyone in the room freeze instinctively.
origin: The doll's Red Light, Green Light song from Squid Game.
